description: Lets the open server's pages use the shell's IPC: window dragging for the custom tab strip (core:default covers the double-click zoom but not start_dragging, which data-tauri-drag-region invokes on mousedown, so that one is granted explicitly), closing the window when Cmd+W lands outside a canvas tab (close), opening external links in the system browser (opener), and receiving the doop:// link that carries a sign-in finished in the system browser back into the app (deep-link, plus the core event it arrives on). This file names no remote origin on purpose: as bundled it covers only local pages (the shell's own shell-dist page, and the devUrl in dev). The one server a launch opens, the default on this computer or the one picked in the app, gets this same capability for its exact origin at runtime (src/server.rs, grant). doop.design is never granted.
